To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the meat quality traits and chemical properties of the meat of PIC hybrid pigs originating from different terminal sire lines (P337 and P410) were comparable, except for the higher incidence of pale soft exudative (PSE) and dark firm dry (DFD) meats, respectively.
the quality of meat from the two terminal lines was good and there was no significant difference in meat quality between the two lines.
the meat quality characteristics of the hybrid pigs from the two terminal sire lines were comparable.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the meat quality traits of hybrid pigs originating two different terminal sire line.
the quality of meat of hybrid pigs originating of two different terminal lines.
the evaluation of meat quality traits in hybrid pigs originating from different terminal sire lines (PIC).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hybrid pigs originating from the P 337 terminal sire line have better meat quality traits than those from the P 410 terminal sire line.
the meat from P410 hybrid pigs is superior in meat quality to that of P337 hybrid pigs.

the meat quality characteristics of hybrid pigs originating of two different terminal sire breeds are similar, but that the meat of P 337 pigs has a higher incidence of PSE and that the meat of the P 410 pigs has a higher frequency of DFD meat.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the meat quality traits of PIC hybrid pigs were within the acceptable range.
both groups of pigs had good meat quality.
the meat from the P 410 line was characterized by higher pH, higher drip loss and higher L* value, and the P 337 line had higher incidence of pale, soft and exudative (PSE) pork and darker meat.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of the two different terminal sire line of the PIC breed in the hybrid pig production is possible.
the use of the P 337 line as a terminal sire line in hybrid pig production is not recommended.
the hybrid pigs originating from P 337 and P 410 terminal sire lines have meat quality traits and chemical compositions that are comparable to those obtained for the commercial hybrid pigs.
